items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maybe we need to get a hold of Larry Applebaum or somebody like that.

ctx.x: Yes. Abbey Lincoln. You know, Abbey Lincoln was, is, was a great singer and a great, great songwriter. I mean, her tunes are incredible. But did she scat? No. She did not scat. Now, I heard a tape, a cassette tape, years ago of a private party, and I don‟t remember who gave me this tape. Unfortunately, it also burned in my fire, when I had my house burn down. Billie at a party, and they said, “Scat, Billie.” And Billie said, “Eh, well...” you know. And she scatted and it was amazing. [laughs] It was amazing. But…
Maybe we need to get a hold of Larry Applebaum or somebody like that.
